## Checklist
- [ ] Branch follows Git flow (`feature/*` → `develop`, `release/*` / `hotfix/*` → `main`)
- [ ] `gradlew compileTestJava` passes; affected scenarios pass locally (`gradlew test -Ptags=...`)
- [ ] New scenarios carry `@REQ`/`@TC` tags and have a flow diagram in `qa/flows/`
- [ ] No real credentials or personal data
- [ ] Known defects are tagged `@bug @BUG-XXX` and documented
